messages:
sophia: Posting final release notes draft and proposed rollout window for v2.3.1. Need quick sign-off from eng/docs/comms. Change window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m wait/checks. Rollback = pin back to release/v2.3.0 and revert routing.
laura: Pasted RN excerpt below. Kept bullet points tight for the blog blurb. LMK edits.
laura: ```
- Fix: reduce KV cache thrash on multi-tenant workloads (10-30% CPU drop)
- Perf: improved batching heuristics for short prompts (<50 tokens)
- Ops: new metrics exported for token-level cost breakdown
- Note: model variant pinned for hosted to redwood-open-3b-quant-v2 for stability
```
product-comms: Looks good. Need a 1-line kibble for the internal digest and a 1-paragraph external blurb. I can draft external after eng sign-off.
sophia: Internal digest line: "v2.3.1: batch + cache improvements, lower costs for short prompts." fine?
product-comms: perfect.
andre: Confirming DB/schema migrations: none in this release, right? we only change runtime behavior.
miguel: Correct, no DB changes. One infra note: we should pin the model artifact to avoid hot-swap during rollout. I suggest pinning model tag -> redwood-open-3b-quant-v2@2026-03-20.
zane: Agree with model pin. Also recommend enabling safe-fallback: if canary error rate > 2% in 15m, auto-rollback.
sophia: Good. Add that into the RN ops section and rollback playbook.
laura: Edited RN ops section: ```
Rollback policy: if canary error rate > 2% OR latency P95 regresses > 30% for two consecutive 5m windows -> trigger automatic rollback to release/v2.3.0. Routing will reassign to stable pool. Contact oncall and postmortem required for >30m outage.
Model pin: hosted -> redwood-open-3b-quant-v2@2026-03-20
```
product-comms: Do we have a pinned time for the internal announcement? prefer to blast after the canary reaches 25%.
sophia: Let's wait until canary 25% success. I'll cue internal digest at that point.
miguel: Request: when scheduling deploy, add capacity buffer in west-eu region (we expect a spike). +10% for 30m after go-live.
zane: noted. Also add observability runbook: quick queries to check: `SELECT count(*) FROM token_events WHERE error=true AND ts > now()-interval '15 minutes'` and `service.latency.p95{env:prod}`
deploy-bot: @channel Deploy request queued by sophia for release/v2.3.1. Scheduled window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary steps: 5% at T0, 25% at T0+20m, 100% at T0+50m. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate>2% OR p95_latency_regress>30%. Command: `/deploy release/v2.3.1 --canary 5,25,100 --wait 15m --rollback-on "err>2% or p95>30%" --pin-model redwood-open-3b-quant-v2@2026-03-20`
sophia: Running the deploy command shortly. thumbs up if no objections. :thumbsup: 
andre: :thumbsup:
product-comms: :thumbsup:
miguel: minor nit: change the wait to 15m between canary steps (deploy-bot shows 20m). prefer 15m.
sophia: updated plan: 5% -> wait 15m -> 25% -> wait 15m -> 100%. deploy-bot requeue pls.
deploy-bot: Deploy re-queued with updated cadence. Canary timings: 5% at T0, 25% at T0+15m, 100% at T0+30m. Safe-fallback configured. Pin confirmed. Oncall contacts: eng-oncall, infra-oncall.
sophia: Thanks everyone — I'll hit the button during the window. I'll post a quick internal update when canary reaches 25% success.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: will post 30 minutes before window opens and again at start time.
deploy-bot: Deploy started (3398765795) — canary 5% in progress."
